declarations.rationale: Chairman title/step-as-chair/depicted-as-chair paths form the largest specific office family; other executive/leader/director roles are not unioned.
Founder possessive/of and found paths dominate; chairman/invention/earnings alone are distinct.
Wing, score-for, goals and play-with paths identify athlete-to-team representation; dismissed-coach paths are a separate role.
Attack/criticize-proposal/offer-case-against paths with political opponents identify a dominant criticism family; military war, mere mention and tell are distinct.
Manager-of, relative-manager and replacement-as-manager form the dominant specific role; officer and coach alone are excluded.
National modifiers of group/company/carrier/consortium/maker dominate. A parent's nationality does not automatically transfer to the subject.
Area-of, neighborhood and section/district-in paths dominate, ordered neighborhood to borough.
Join/join-with dominates with political parties jointly acting; criticism and outnumbering are separate. Omitted joint action remains ambiguous.

Direct analyst-nominal and direct official-nominal/at families each supply5 rows; the highest individually interpretable path analyst-nn(5) exceeds official-nn(3), resolving the tie to analyst. Dateline-to-official-says paths do not themselves assert an official role for a city.
Succeeded-as-chairman, chairman tenure and explicit-chair paths total13 rows, exceeding chief-nominal8. Other chief/leader roles remain separate.
Member, held-seat, served-on and resignation paths dominate with people/countries to institutions; alliance or travel alone is insufficient.

Full ordered-role inspection identifies8 run/director/president office rows, versus7 political vote/join-together rows. Institutional managerial office is the largest coherent family; joining a team/alliance and political voting are excluded.

Dominant paths are co-subject corporate-name fragments and datelines. Remaining transfer-to2 and victim death/wound2 families tie without a clearer individually interpretable dominant path; ownership and manager each add only1. No stable substantive relation is identifiable; retain all cases as unresolved rather than invent an association predicate.
Coach and team-said-coach constructions dominate with team-to-coach roles. Co-subject datelines and family teaching are distinct.
Chairman paths supply8 rows, exceeding co-founder/found6; founding and mogul/ownership alone are not chairmanship.

Country-to-country ambassador-to, relation-with and relationship-with paths dominate. Diplomatic relations is the coherent family; generic relationships alone retain uncertainty and person-to-person communication is separate.
Spokesman/spokeswoman and spelling-variant paths dominate; secretary/consultant and executive succession alone are excluded.

Obituary relative-of-city paths with first-name-to-Manhattan roles plus explicit live-in identify a residence dictionary; attachment to another relative must remain ambiguous, not treated as kinship to the city.
Owner/own appositive paths form the largest coherent family (6 rows); publisher, political push-through and residence are separate.
Wife apposition and accompanied/introduced/flanked-by-wife dominate; alliance and political address are excluded.
Owner/co-owner/restaurant ownership and co-owns dominate; managing operations and institutional movement do not establish ownership.
Sit-on and membership plus institutional-entry paths form the largest coherent family after checking country/committee roles. Physical building entry is a competing meaning.

Seven company/conglomerate/group/product nationality modifier paths identify the coherent Unilever national-affiliation family, exceeding four inverse-leader rows; leadership, death and broadcast timing are distinct.
Victim killed-in/death-after-crash-in paths identify death location; active killer-subject paths, expulsion, injury alone and population percentages are excluded.
Run, executive, head, leader/chair and director form a genuinely mixed institutional managerial-office family. Ownership or athletic trade alone is excluded.
